title: Xiaomi releases MiMo v2.5 base native-omni model
summary: Alongside MiMo v2.5 Pro, Xiaomi has released MiMo v2.5, the base model in the family, as a native omni model with multimodal understanding and integrated agent capabilities. Both models ship under the MIT license.

research.notes: Native omni model; multimodal understanding plus agent capabilities. MIT license.
